# Upstream LMDB's leftover SysV semaphore sets, removed 2026-10-26

After the merge of jolt/lmdb-sysv-sem-identity (LMDB 15420ce, six semaphores a set), upstream's two-semaphore sets
(253ba52) were removed on root's go. Rule: exactly 2 semaphores, key 0x4d......, owned by sean; skipped if its key is a
store held open by a process still on 253ba52 (lsof at removal time) or a live process last operated either semaphore.
Six- and one-semaphore sets were left. Tool: a scratch C program over semctl (IPC_STAT, GETPID, IPC_RMID).

- ipcs before: 10 sets of 1, 6408 sets of 2, 35 sets of 6, 
- ipcs after: 10 sets of 1, 42 sets of 2, 35 sets of 6, 
- removed 6366; skipped: held 2, live 39, not 2 semaphores 0, key 0, owner 0, gone 1, failed 0
- old-build processes at removal: one-go's 10 roots, zygote-one-mode's test run, agent-loop; their stores' keys: 0x4d0d68cb 0x4d0d704b 0x4d0d47e7
